cases.prompt: 尽量一次做完这个跨文件修复：检查、实现、测试、文档、Git 收尾都由你连续推进；遇到必须我做的登录或 MFA 才停。
Continue executing the authorized implementation. Reduce handoffs, preserve existing edits, and report only real blockers.
Turn this multi-stage migration into one self-contained work package with user-only blockers and retry rules.
请先一次性检查历史、分支、工作区、权限和外部依赖，然后在授权范围内持续完成剩余工作。
The task includes code changes, deterministic tests, docs, evidence, and a clean handoff. Execute it as one bounded workpack.
少打扰我，但请持续告诉我做到哪里；每次进度不需要等我回复。
直接执行整个任务。不要每一步问我，也不要十分钟不说话；用简洁的阶段进度主动汇报。
Use two independent subagents to audit in parallel, but have the main thread report their roles, completed count, findings, and integration status.
Run the whole authorized local release-preparation package, but do not publish or deploy without explicit permission.
Continue autonomously with concise, non-blocking progress updates. If a test fails, diagnose and retry within scope, then distinguish partial from complete.
请只解释这个函数做什么，不要修改文件。
请只审查这份计划并列出风险。
请把这段话翻译成中文。
